content.evidence: Episode numbers come from WDM_pc_PC_101..103 archive names in archives; the mapping was not confirmed by playing each episode on this machine.

steamDrm.evidence: WalkingDeadMichonne.exe imports steam_api.dll; Steam remains the gate.
steamDrm.policy: Never bypassed. Steam Offline Mode with a cached licence is the supported offline path.

publisherServices.evidence: String literals inside WalkingDeadMichonne.exe, read on this machine. www.telltalegames.com is a store link, not a startup call.
publisherServices.runtimeObservation: Not observed. No packet capture or netstat sample was taken while this build was running.

verified: the installed executable matches the sha256 this patch is written for, so the patch applies to this build only
the publisher endpoint was located as a string literal in the shipped executable
installing and removing the endpoint pin restores the hosts file byte-for-byte (same mechanics as tests/Run-Tests.ps1 covers for the shared tool)
untested: the offline launch wait on this build: no launch was timed under a network cut-off
gameplay, saves, episode transitions and achievements offline on this build
offlinePatch.crossReference: The launch fix itself is Steam's own Offline Mode switch, measured on Season 1 in docs/rea/19-offline-launch-stall.md (condition D: usable frontend at 11.63 s with the client and game cut off, against no launch in 220 s without it). It is a client-wide setting, not a per-game one.
